properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
TULI boonoonyi ddala,
Abasibiddwa-ebibi;
Ggwe abeera-abanaku,
Otusaasire,Yesu

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Tetulina bulungi
Mu byonna bye tukola,
Ggwe-otegeera bwe tuli,
Otusaasire,Yesu

verse.name: v3
v4
verse.lines:
Ssetaani yatusiba
Mu kkomera ly'ebibi ;
Otufuule ba ddembe,
Otusaasire,Yesu.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ali omu mu ggulu
Atulokola yekka,
Tatuggalira bweru;
Otusaasire,Yesu.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Ye atuwolereza,
Mu maaso ga Katonda,
Ku bw'oyo tuwangula,
Tulituuka mu ggulu
